value.rationale: The exact threshold halves or improves a broad sufficient stabilization budget for natural commuting linearized gradient systems, and a rigorous sign-reentry example shows that energy and positivity respond nonmonotonically to stabilizer strength. The accompanying exact spectral-midpoint optimizer specifies which stable stabilizer gives optimal stiff-limit damping. Each answers a concrete design question in a published energy-decreasing integration method; no generic mathematical restatement or arbitrary slicing is offered.
